heroSubheading: Budget-friendly, reliable relocations for students moving to halls, shared HMO houses, or returning home across the UK. Low rates and small-load flexibility.
summary: Heading to university or changing student halls? Our budget-friendly Birmingham movers provide fast, stress-free student relocations for undergraduates and postgraduates attending University of Birmingham in Selly Oak, Aston University, Birmingham City University, or Coventry University. Our agile removal van carries desks, luggage, textbooks, and bedroom furniture with ease. Split the cost per hour with housemates or book a dedicated door-to-door slot with full transit insurance included.
benefits: Discounted student-friendly rates with no hidden booking fees
Serving University of Birmingham, Aston, BCU, Newman, Coventry, and Warwick
Door-to-door transfers between student halls, shared houses, and family homes
Flexible collection dates matching university term schedules
Affordable summer box storage with return delivery in September

process.title: Quick Online or WhatsApp Quote
process.description: Tell us how many suitcases, boxes, and furniture items you have and your current student address.

process.title: Collection at Halls or House
process.description: Our friendly driver arrives at your campus halls or student house to help load your boxes, bedding, and PC gear.

process.title: Direct Transit or Summer Storage
process.description: We either drive directly to your new accommodation or store your boxes safely in our alarmed facility over the summer.

process.title: Fresh Term Delivery
process.description: We deliver your belongings straight to your new university room at the start of the autumn semester.

whatsIncluded: Clean removal van with driver and loading assistance
Door-to-room delivery where parking access permits
Transit blankets for laptops, TVs, and monitors
Full Goods in Transit insurance protection
Flexible booking cancellations with 48 hours notice
whatsNotIncluded: End of tenancy deep cleaning services
Supply of packing boxes unless ordered in advance
Disposal of accumulated household rubbish left by housemates
Split collections across more than two distinct addresses without prior agreement
priceNotes: Achievable starting price for a local room move (up to 8 boxes, suitcase, and bicycle) within 5 miles of Birmingham university campuses.

faqs.question: Can two students share a van to reduce moving costs?
faqs.answer: Yes! If you and a friend or housemate are moving from the same student property or to adjacent accommodations, sharing a van is a great way to split the cost.

faqs.question: Do you deliver to London, Manchester, Leeds, or other UK university cities?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer nationwide student relocation, moving students directly back home or to postgraduate universities across the UK.

faqs.question: Can you collect from multi-storey student hall accommodation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we are familiar with campus halls across Birmingham (including Selly Oak, Vale Village, and city-centre campus accommodation). We assist with lift and corridor transfers.

faqs.question: Can I store my things with you over the summer vacation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we collect your belongings in June, store them in our secure warehouse, and deliver them back to your new flat or house in September.
